text:
tom.huang: Finished deploy to prod-e (rollout 20%). Starting focused post-deploy smoke for 12m. @deploy-bot run lightweight probes: health, kv-synth, chat-short, embed-tiny. runbook: https://redwood.local/runbooks/postdeploy-smoke :hourglass:
deploy-bot: Deploy logged: release=2026.3.3, cohort=prod-e, hosts=96, duration=3m02s. Probe multiplier=2x, sampling targets=health(100%), kv(50), chat(50), embed(30). Summary will post here.
rita.sre: Quick health curl:
``
curl -s https://prod-e.api.redwood/v1/health | jq '.'
{
  "ok": true,
  "ready_shards": 96
}
```
rita.sre: After 6m: kv p95=165ms (baseline 150), chat p95=360ms (baseline 340), embed p95=420ms (baseline 300). EU embed route showing higher tail, error mix 429+503 ~1.8%.
grace: Noticing embed queue depth increase on host gpu-eu-7. Pod backlog spike coincident with deploy window. No 5xx spike elsewhere.
oncall: Checking infra: kube events show short lived RestartBackOff on gpu-eu-7 around +90s. Node shows elevated memory pressure. K8s autoscaler reacted but scaled after 40s.
rita.sre: Temp mitigation: reduce embed batch size 48->32, divert 10% embed traffic to fallback variant v2026.3.2, restart gpu-eu-7 pod. Re-running probes.
deploy-bot: Applied traffic split: embed.variant=v2026.3.2 weight=10% for cohort=prod-e. Batch size override applied.
rita.sre: T+4m after mitigation: embed p95 dropped to 290ms, errors down to 0.3%. kv and chat stable. Looks like batch size + small diversion helped.
pm-dave: Any customer-facing impact? Support reports none. Decision options: rollback, pin to cohort, or continue hold.
tom.huang: Hold ramp at 20% and pin rollout to prod-e only while we watch for 20m. Rollback criteria: combined 5xx+429 > 3% for 10m OR embed p95 > 600ms for 5m. If stable T+20m, resume gradual ramp.
oncall: Opening short-lived incident log and keeping autoscaler advisory enabled.
grace: I'll keep traces for gpu-eu-7 and check model-side memory allocs.
rita.sre: Will run increased synths (every 90s) and post metrics at T+10m and T+20m.
tom.huang: OK thanks. Actions: ops monitor node, irq to autoscaler, rita keep probes, grace dig into model memory. Reconvene T+20m. :white_check_mark:
